prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Festive light glowing soft in the background bokeh; in focus, the counter becomes a joyful production line — a big pot of sauce ladled into containers, a lasagna assembled in fast layers, dishes covered and stacked. Money shot: the freezer door opening and receiving a row of prepared trays one by one, cold light revealing the ready stockpile. Final beat: apron pulled off and tossed on the hook, car keys grabbed from the counter, out the door — free. Warm light against the cool freezer glow, film grain. Dominant sound: the ladle pours, then the freezer seal. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Uma hora hoje compra o feriado inteiro de tranquilidade.

Casa cheia amanhã e a única coisa na sua lista é... aproveitar.

Manda pro grupo do feriadão 👇
